review findings red-first: 12 red tests confirmed on candidate fbdf7dc before any fix — turn-orchestrator hydration poison (getRuntimeStats re-hydrated every tracked conversation via buildConversationQueueSnapshot during active queue AND after drain), sse-bus physical-destroy assertions (budget/oversize/deadline removals only end()ed), metrics offset-window UTC selection (04:00Z row dropped by raw +08:00 TEXT comparison), impossible calendar dates (2026-02-31/04-31 passed validation), agent-eval-report baseline JS type semantics (boolean counts folded to 1, durationMs:true counted, object/array/true tool buckets wrong), stream-recovery trailing episode dropped during in-flight refresh

HIGH finding fix: getRuntimeStats is now pure O(1) map probes (activeTurns, non-idle queueStates, activeAgentSlots); queue settlement moved into queue lifecycle — drain loop settles in its finally when the final poll found the queue empty (drainedIdle, after dispatch marker release), goal-continuation poll settles when nothing pending and not claimed, getConversationMutationState settles when its own depth probe proved the queue empty (deletion busy-gate created permanently non-idle entries); settle marks entries idle=true instead of deleting (deleting dropped the in-memory consumed-cursor; recreation relies on persisted metadata that mock stores lack — caught by the failed-batches-retry test); drainConversationQueue clears idle when it starts; buildRuntimePayload keeps the pre-existing sweep for broadcasts

SSE finding fix: endClientStream(client, {force}) — byte-budget, drain-deadline, oversize-frame, and write-error removals now end()+destroy() the response so the stalled socket and its accepted writable buffer release immediately (end() alone left the buffer alive on a never-flushing socket while stats already reported zero); unit tests now assert physical destroy; gate blocked-client scenario tracks server-side sockets via liveSockets and asserts physical teardown (authoritative side is the server: a paused client keeps unread bytes in its own kernel receive buffer)

metrics window finding fix: every boundary normalizes to a canonical UTC instant (date-only midnight / next-midnight exclusive end-of-day, Z and ±HH:MM offsets converted, zone-less datetimes defined as UTC wall-clock matching baseline lexical semantics) so TEXT comparison against persisted UTC created_at is chronological; impossible calendar dates rejected via Date.UTC round-trip (Date.parse silently normalizes 2026-02-31 via legacy parser); CLI normalizeIsoBoundary copy fixed the same way and throws a clear error on invalid boundaries (unbounded mode unchanged: omit boundaries entirely)

metrics type-semantics finding fix: json_type-gated projections keep exact baseline JSON.parse semantics — count fields fold json_type IN (integer,real) into SQL so booleans never count; durationMs folded to JSON numbers so true never enters percentiles; tool/status/expectations values reconstructed via jsonJsValue from compact integer type codes (object→[object Object], array→reparsed small subtree join, true→'true'); first attempt used json_type() string columns and broke the 512MiB RSS gate (484k event rows x ~50B strings ≈ +170MiB → 577-583MiB FAIL), fixed with compact integer codes and a split of the event query by family (expectations 7 cols / tool-calls 7 cols vs combined 13) — concurrent RSS delta 528→125.7MiB, single-report 403.2MiB, exact aggregate parity still verified field-by-field

stream-recovery finding fix: shouldRecoverOnOpen coalesces an in-flight-episode reopen as pendingRecovery; finishRecovery returns true when a trailing episode is pending so the caller runs exactly one serialized trailing refreshAll(state.selectedConversationId re-read fresh); a failing first refresh cannot lose the trailing episode (latch releases in finally regardless); app.js open handler runs runRecoveryRefresh with the trailing retry loop; no parallel refreshes ever
